children: Motilal Oswal's research report on HDFC AMC

HDFC AMC’s operating revenue grew 14% YoY/6% QoQ to ~INR11.7b (inline). Yields came in at 48.5bp in 2QFY27 vs 46.6bp in 2QFY26 and 47bp in 1QFY27. For 1HFY27, revenue grew 14% YoY to INR22.7b. Total opex at INR2.4b grew 6% YoY but declined 4% QoQ. Employee costs at INR1.4b were up 15% YoY but remained flat QoQ while other expenses at ~INR948m were down 6% YoY/8% QoQ. As a bp of AUM, opex was 9.9bp vs. 10.3bp in 2QFY26 and 10.7bp in 1QFY27. EBITDA came in at INR9.3b (5% beat due to lower opex), up 16% YoY/9% QoQ. EBITDA margin stood at 79.5% vs. 77.9% in 2QFY26 and 77.3% in 1QFY27. For 1HFY27, EBITDA grew 13% YoY to INR17.8b.

We broadly retain our earnings estimates for FY27/FY28 based on its 2Q performance. We expect its revenue/EBITDA/PAT to deliver a 14%/14%/ 13% CAGR, alongside ~13% AUM growth over FY26–28. We reiterate our BUY rating with a TP of INR2,900, based on 40x FY28E core EPS.
